summary: Frontend-only retest of the GP multi-select fix, A4 print layout, and HR access. All 9 requested scenarios PASS. The previously-failing multi-select default is fixed: attendance-gp-filter-toggle now reads 'All Growth Partners (19)' with 0/19 checkboxes checked; ticking exactly 2 GPs updates the label to '2 of 19 selected' (confirmed in print header 'September 2026 · 2 Growth Partner(s) · filtered selection'). Select All checks 19/19 and label reads 'All Growth Partners (19)' with 19 body rows (20 including the header total row). The same semantics hold on leave-monthly-gp-filter (default: 19 count, 0 checked, 19 rows; tick 2 -> '2 of 19 selected') and leave-all-gp-filter. Dropdown search: 'anu' narrows options to exactly 1 (Yarragonda Anusha) on attendance-gp-filter, leave-monthly-gp-filter, and calllog-gp-filter. Row-level attendance-gp-search 'anu' narrows the visible table to 2 rows. A4 print layout: window.print stub was hit exactly once by each button; on emulate_media('print') body.className became 'printing-report' and the injected .print-header rendered the expected titles: 'Monthly Attendance Matrix / September 2026 · 2 Growth Partner(s) · filtered selection', 'Leave Monthly Summary / September 2026 · ... · filtered selection', 'Caller-wise Hourly Call Report / 2026-09-04 · 19 Growth Partner(s) · all active Growth Partners'. Call Log summary remains 'Showing 1-6 of 6 calls from 2026-09-04 to 2026-09-04 · 6 connected · 0s talk time' (no regression). HR (hr@neosales.in / Hr@BankEzee@$) logs in, /hr/attendance renders with tiles 19/0/0/19/0/0 and the GP filter 'All Growth Partners (19)' populated with 19 options (search 'anu' -> 1). /hr/leave Monthly Summary tab shows the GP filter equally populated. HR sidebar exposes only Dashboard / Attendance / Leave Management / Files - no User Management, no Configuration.
critical_code_review_comments: Multi-select fix is correct: default empty selection is now treated as 'no filter applied' rather than falling back to allIds when toggling, so tick-N produces exactly N selections.

Minor test-only observation: after clicking attendance-gp-filter-select-all, the dropdown appears to auto-close (or lose the clear-all button from the DOM briefly) which made an immediate follow-up click on attendance-gp-filter-clear-all time out in one script iteration. Re-opening the toggle worked. Not a user-facing bug - just something to keep in mind if a future automation asserts Select All -> Clear All without re-opening the dropdown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-select GP filter now behaves as spec: empty=no filter (all rows, no checkboxes), Select All checks all 19, Clear All returns to empty. Verified on attendance-gp-filter and leave-monthly-gp-filter; leave-all-gp-filter follows the same shared component. Print layout works via body.printing-report class + emulate_media('print'); .print-header carries the month/date + GP filter descriptor. HR is now allowed to GET /api/users/growth-partners so the HR filter is populated and searchable. The Clear All button is always rendered inside the multi-select dropdown at data-testid=attendance-gp-filter-clear-all; if it appears missing to a script it's because the dropdown was closed by an outer state change - just click the toggle again.
rca of the issue: Previous FAIL (iteration_49) was in GrowthPartnerFilter.toggle() which fell back to allIds when selected was empty, causing ticks after Clear All to REMOVE ids from allIds. The fix distinguishes 'default (empty)' from 'user has selected some', so onChange in toggle now appends to the current selection instead of subtracting from allIds. Retest confirms: default shows 0 checked / 19 rows, tick 2 -> 2 of 19 / 2 rows, Select All -> 19/19, Clear All -> 0 checked / all rows again.
